subject: POC access & MAP: draft and dependencies
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Jennings <olivia@acme-bio.com>; Carlos Mendes <carlos.mendes@acme-bio.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Feb 2026 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: POC access & MAP: draft and dependencies

Hi Olivia / Carlos —

Thanks again for the call today. Per our discussion I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the POC milestones and the environment setup dependencies we need to unblock evaluation. Summary below and next steps at the bottom.

Key MAP milestone (POC environment setup):
- Target kickoff: 2026-03-09 (proposed)
- Redwood owner: Rishi Malhotra (SE)
- Acme owner: Carlos Mendes (Cloud/Infra)
- Success criteria: live inference endpoint reachable from Acme VPC, sample workload executed, basic auth/SSO validated, and secret encryption verified.

Dependencies we flagged on the call (please confirm):
1) VPC peering / connectivity: AWS VPC peering or PrivateLink. We'll need Acme account ID or peering config.
2) IP allowlists: egress IP set for Acme firewall (we will provide exact CIDRs once peering is selected).
3) SSO / SAML: support for SAML 2.0 IdP metadata and a test user account for initial login.
4) Secrets / KMS: whether Acme will provide a customer-managed KMS key (ARN) or permit Redwood-managed keys for the POC.
5) Optional: proxy/bastion requirements for restricted subnets; specify if only private endpoints are allowed.

Attached: mutual-action-plan-acme-20260228.xlsx (MAP draft) — includes milestone table, owners, and a week-by-week plan.

Immediate asks / next steps:
- Carlos: please confirm which connectivity pattern you prefer (VPC peering vs PrivateLink) and provide the AWS account ID if peering is OK.
- Carlos/Infra: confirm whether you require customer-managed KMS or are OK with Redwood-managed keys for the POC.
- Olivia: confirm target kickoff date (proposed 2026-03-09) and any blackout windows.

I'll loop in Rishi to provide the low-level network details and a short checklist we can hand to your cloud team.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

—
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales – Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

From: Olivia Jennings <olivia@acme-bio.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendes <carlos.mendes@acme-bio.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Feb 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC access & MAP: draft and dependencies

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap and the MAP draft; this is helpful. A few clarifications from our infra/security teams before we can lock dates: 

- Connectivity preference: we typically prefer VPC peering for shorter setup time, but PrivateLink is also acceptable if you recommend it for security. If we proceed with peering, our AWS account ID is 987654321098 (please confirm the exact VPC ID requirements).
- IP allowlist: we'll need Redwood's egress CIDRs. Can you provide an estimated list (or a short-lived range) for the POC?
- SSO/SAML: we use Okta as IdP (SAML 2.0). Please confirm what fields you need in the IdP metadata and whether you require signed assertions.
- KMS: for POC we'd prefer Redwood-managed keys initially to avoid procurement delays, but we will need the option to bring our own key later. Please confirm if Redwood supports customer-managed KMS ARNs.

Carlos (cc) will be the point on our side for infra. He will coordinate with our security/compliance team.

Also: any expected timeline for the initial peering config? Our security team generally wants at least a 3-business-day window for reviewing network changes.

Best,
Olivia
Director of Product – Acme Bio
olivia@acme-bio.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Mendes <carlos.mendes@acme-bio.com>, Olivia Jennings <olivia@acme-bio.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 01 Mar 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC access & MAP: draft and dependencies

Hi Olivia / Carlos —

Appreciate the quick responses. A few concrete items from the SE side to make the MAP POC milestone actionable. I'll own the Redwood tasks listed below.

Technical notes / what we need from Acme (short checklist):
- VPC peering path: if you choose peering, please share the AWS account ID and the VPC ID you want to peer (we will create a peering connection request from our side). For PrivateLink we will provide an endpoint service name instead.
- IP allowlist: for initial POC you can allow the following approximate egress ranges (we'll confirm exact CIDRs after peering): 18.202.0.0/16, 3.210.0.0/16. If you have stricter requirements we can provide per-region ranges.
- SSO/SAML: Redwood supports SAML 2.0 with signed assertions. We need IdP metadata XML (or the metadata URL), ACS URL: https://accounts.redwood.ai/saml/acs, EntityID: https://accounts.redwood.ai/saml/metadata. A test Okta user with an email in the Acme domain is sufficient for validation.
- Secrets/KMS: Redwood supports customer-managed KMS keys (KMS ARN) or Redwood-managed keys. For the POC, Redwood-managed keys are fine; if you want CMK please provide Key ARN and grant the Redwood service principal decrypt/encrypt permissions.
- Ports/Protocols: we use HTTPS (443) for control-plane and inference traffic. If you require a bastion or restricted subnet access, let us know and we can provide a short-lived jumpbox option.

Proposed MAP updates (I will update the attached PDF):
- Milestone: POC environment available -> owner Rishi Malhotra -> target: 2026-03-11 (gives 1 week after proposed kickoff to finalize peering & KMS)
- Milestone: SSO validated -> owner: Tessa Morgan -> target: 2026-03-12
- Milestone: Run validation workload -> owner: Acme / Carlos -> target: 2026-03-15

Attachments: mutual-action-plan-acme-20260301.pdf (updated with technical checklist).

If Carlos can confirm peering vs PrivateLink and the AWS account/VPC ID this week, I can start the peering request and provide the exact CIDRs and connection steps.

Thanks,
Rishi
Senior Sales Engineer – Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0199
